effects.effect: While you are in your wolf form, your [size](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) is 1L, you have a +2 [bonus](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to [speed](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed), and you ignore [difficult terrain](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain).
